name: mowteng
description: Hosted MCP server for Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, Yandex Webmaster and IndexNow: search performance, URL inspection, sitemap submission, IndexNow pings and computed SEO analyses (content decay, striking distance, cannibalization, index audit, Google vs Bing gaps).
